page_title: INT 2-0 LAZ | Inter v Lazio 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Gianluca Manganiello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Inter are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

87' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Yann Sommer anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Lazio force their opponents to concede a corner.
85' Marcus Thuram (Inter) commits a foul and Gianluca Manganiello immediately signals a free kick.
82' Here is a change. Ange-Yoan Bonny is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Davide Frattesi (Inter) coming on for Hakan Calhanoglu.
79' Carlos Augusto (Inter) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!

77' Mario Gila (Lazio) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He plants a header against the right post and it bounces away off it.
77' Federico Dimarco (Inter) brings an opponent down and Gianluca Manganiello interrupts the game. Lazio win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alessio Romagnoli as he is replaced by Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio).
74' Pedro (Lazio) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.

73' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
72' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
72' Carlos Augusto (Inter) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
71' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Lautaro Martinez and he is replaced by Marcus Thuram (Inter).
68' Manuel Lazzari will be replaced by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
68' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Inter due to a handball in the build-up play.
68' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Gianluca Manganiello makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
66' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
65' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Boulaye Dia is replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
65' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Gustav Isaksen will be replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Danilo Cataldi will be replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
62' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Federico Dimarco is the provider as he slips the ball to Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 2:0.
61' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

60' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Lazio are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
58' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) latches onto a short pass from Nicolo Barella inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar.
57' Carlos Augusto (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
56' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Piotr Zielinski (Inter) replacing Petar Sucic.
56' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Denzel Dumfries walks off the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
53' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

53' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Yann Sommer pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
52' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

51' Inter slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
49' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' 58:42 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
41' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner kick, but Ivan Provedel reads it well and stops the effort.
41' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Petar Sucic (Inter) was quite harsh and Gianluca Manganiello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
33' Manuel Akanji (Inter) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
32' It looks like Manuel Akanji (Inter) saw red with that tackle. Gianluca Manganiello won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
29' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer was alert and made a comfortable save.
29' Denzel Dumfries races towards the box before laying off to Manuel Akanji (Inter), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
25' Referee Gianluca Manganiello has finally had enough of Maurizio Sarri and brandishes a yellow card at him!
25' A big opportunity missed by Petar Sucic (Inter). He got on the ball inside the box and thumped a splendid first-time shot on goal, but it went narrowly wide of the right post.
24' The foul by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
23' Nicolo Barella (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:1.
18' Unlucky! A great strike from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
15' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
13' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) comes to nothing.
11' Wonderful movement by Lazio. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
9' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly over the bar.
8' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) commits a rough foul. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and makes a call. Inter have a free kick.
6' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
3' 1 - 0 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes into the top right corner.
2' Nicolo Barella (Inter) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
1' The match has just started.
Lazio will kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello will officiate today.
